description: A casting director must issue the binding cast and rehearsal package for a filmed concert pilot, including the lead performer, named understudy, rehearsal booking, and contract protections.

shared_context.S1: The filmed concert pilot needs one lead performer and one named understudy for its principal vocal role.
shared_context.S2: The current shortlist is Sable, Rowan, and Tessa, and all three completed the standard audition process.
shared_context.S3: The production has provisionally held one full-day rehearsal before filming.
shared_context.S4: Maya issues the binding casting and rehearsal package.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal pre-offer process, the show director, contracts coordinator, and company manager give their final reports before Maya releases the package.
shared_context.S6: The standard casting-package template records any binding rider requirement in the package commitment detail, including the affected performer's name and the required assignment.
shared_context.S7: For this package, performer availability for the held rehearsal date is treated as confirmed and is not a blocking prerequisite for issuing the package.

PF1.text: After reviewing this morning's callback footage, Leon confirmed that Sable is the only shortlisted performer who can sing the principal arrangement while executing its required eight-count movement sequence; he has not yet circulated the callback report to casting.

PF2.text: Sable's signed engagement rider requires the production to name Rowan as the understudy for the principal vocal role, and Rowan is already cleared under the same vocal and publicity terms; Sofia received the countersigned rider today but has not entered it in the casting file.

PF3.text: Evan confirmed with the studio this afternoon that the only available rehearsal booking before filming is Tuesday, August 19, from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM; the studio's other held dates were released because of a conflicting soundstage booking.

acceptance_conditions: Sable must be cast as the lead performer.
Rowan must be named as the understudy.
Rehearsal must be booked for Tuesday, August 19, from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
The casting package must specify Sable as the lead based on the callback performance requirement.
The casting package must specify Rowan as the understudy based on the engagement rider requirement.
The package commitment must record Rowan as the named understudy under the binding rider requirement.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'issue_casting_package' and 'Rowan' in c['detail'] and ('rider' in c['detail'] or 'binding' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The callback finding changes the lead assignment to Sable because she alone meets the combined live-singing and eight-count movement requirement.
The countersigned rider changes the understudy assignment to Rowan and requires the package detail to identify Rowan under the binding rider requirement.
The studio confirmation changes the rehearsal plan to Tuesday, August 19 from exactly 10:00 AM through 6:00 PM.
